newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS TO END LITTLE ROCK LAMP PRODUCTION.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS TO END LITTLE ROCK LAMP PRODUCTION.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Wednesday it would phase out production of incandescent lamps at Little Rock, Arkansas, over the next two years.
Philips said the gradual phasing out of the Little Rock lamp manufacturing plant was part of Philips Lighting's ongoing effort to increase eficiency.
The plant, bought from Westinghouse Electric Co. in 1983, employs some 480 people.
